contract.continuation: Hold last planned action for every policy; no hidden Fixed/OneMove tail switch
contract.deadline: One absolute entered_at/solve_deadline/first_action_at/action_deadline window; all solver and ranking costs checked, actuation/ACK remains coordinator-owned
contract.fixed: Full constant-action training reference, frozen before Eval; runtime fixed_action invokes no simulator
contract.future_prefix: Hold received budget until caller-specified first_action_at after solver deadline; never backdate
contract.scenario_input: Typed caller input, provenance-bound to source state; development or past observations only. Provenance declarations do not establish nonleakage.
tie_order: prefer first action holding received budget

failures.retained_source_defect: Attempt01 had 10PASS but source review found replaceable parameter/identity binding; old bytes retained. Attempt02 freezes that binding and adds a regression. This was not an observed failed first test run.

final_tests.other_python: Not run under this bounded one-focused-run-plus-concrete-fix instruction

implementation.binding_correction: Concrete source-review defect after initial 10PASS: mutable NominalPlanner.parameters/identity attributes could retain an old identity while replacing parameters. Freeze the wrapper binding and add one failure-sensitive regression. No stochastic search or tuning.
implementation.data_boundary: CausalScenario source hashes/origin/purpose are caller declarations, not proof of disjoint data. Origin evaluation_future and future-available/cutoff inputs refuse. No real data was read.
implementation.fixed: Both constant paths required in each training panel; freeze_fixed is a nominal TRAIN forecast reference, NOT empirical GPU best-Fixed qualification. fixed_action does zero runtime rollouts.
implementation.forecast: Calls unchanged mpc_lab.model.rollout for all eight paths, one explicit typed causal nominal scenario. No NativeScenario construction, no generated RNG scenarios.
implementation.objective: Public resolved-complete-success TTFT<=0.5 lower count; exact Fraction ordering, not native natural_slo_good or cohort-wall ranking.
implementation.one_move: At most one planned transition from received budget, including delayed transition; hold last action into tail.
implementation.time: Observed budget held until absolute first_action_at; fresh source and guarded current run/domain/identity/budget-version/ledger-sequence checked through final selection; source-derived action expiry included in typed proposal.

negative_controls: real full MPC versus strong OneMove and all fixed paths
full-action Train Fixed selection and zero runtime simulator calls
frozen model/identity cannot be replaced or retuned under v1
remaining_integration: The live coordinator must honor not_before and revalidate the absolute deadline; no backdating or synthetic application ACK.
Budget/version callbacks here are trusted injected interfaces, not an implemented concurrent transport.
Cooperative checks can reject late work but are not OS hard-real-time preemption.
Complete observed gateway ledger and actual model/source identity must be bound by coordinator; no Native hidden state has been observed.
